meta.title: The State of Digital Transformation in Schools
meta.description: A short survey on digital systems in schools: current use, the biggest challenges, and future needs.

welcome.title: The State of Digital Transformation in Schools
welcome.body: As digital solutions evolve fast, systems and platforms have become a core part of running a school. This survey looks at how schools use them today, the biggest challenges, and what they need next — from the point of view of the people who work in schools.
welcome.privacy: Results are used for research and product development.
